releaseNotes:
1. Fast Google Maps (Road, Satellite, Hybrid) with RAM LRU & Disk Tile Caching and parallel subdomains.
2. English & Tamil (EN | தமிழ்) toggle showing Feeder Names in Tamil everywhere.
3. Routine Patrol module with RP.db, Date & Time photo stamping (no GPS), and <3MB JPEG/PDF/CSV reports.
4. Dedicated PM.db, RP.db, and SPL.db SQLite databases with auto-migration.
5. Database Backup / Restore & Share (PM, SPL, RP) with ZIP bundle support.
